title: BUG: app permission dialogs ('allow once') appear on operator-ordered steps (e.g. write to F:/ outside session folders, Bash/ToolSearch), blocking unattended Supervisor/worker runs. Fix: pre-approve in .claude/settings.json allow rules (F:/MTS_backup*, scripts/dev/*, git -C), run Supervisor sessions in a permission mode that does not prompt, and make briefs avoid out-of-folder writes; document in SURFACE_POLICY.md
evidence: Screenshot 3c19a6836b52 (2026-10-26, NUC): dialog 'Allow Claude to run Back up dirty files, then fast-forward pull?' for a Bash call (mkdir/cp to /f/MTS_backup_dirty + git pull), while the session footer reads 'Bypass permissions'. So a prompt appears even in bypass mode; likely the app's out-of-folder write guard (F:) or sandbox, not MTS.
